assumptions: The product remains an administrative exception-checking layer and never represents its output as a legal-entitlement decision.
A qualified Polish public-procurement specialist approves the initial rules pack and material rule changes; AI assists extraction and regression testing but does not replace that responsibility.
The family-business project can provide a permissioned prototype environment, but it supplies neither independent demand evidence nor an incumbent distribution relationship.

At least one authority and contract-form family recurs often enough within a partner portfolio to make a shared rules pack technically possible; the economic sufficiency of that recurrence remains unknown.
The stated 60000 PLN can fund a narrow prototype and limited specialist review, but not an assumed full enterprise integration, prolonged partner sales cycle, or open-ended support obligation.

factors.name: Core insight
factors.rationale: The opportunity correctly isolates a recurring statutory and operational evidence gate, then avoids competing as another document repository by placing a source-linked exception layer inside an incumbent workflow. Officially documented defect categories support the insight. Its ceiling is limited because it is still unproven that the gap is a separable product rather than functionality an incumbent can readily add.

factors.name: Customer pain and willingness to pay
factors.rationale: Delayed construction payment is cash-flow-critical, and GDDKiA directly documents multiple curable evidence defects plus substantial direct-payment activity. However, the reviewed figures do not isolate delays caused by those defects, and there is no evidence that the proposed ERP/DMS partner regards the narrow rules module as important enough to fund rather than build, bundle, or ignore.

factors.name: Business model and economics
factors.rationale: Implementation plus recurring portfolio licensing is structurally better than reacquiring each project, and one maintained pack could amortize specialist review. Yet price, partner margin, activation, renewal, sales-cycle length, integration cost, support burden, mature gross margin, payback, and owner earnings are all unknown. A powerful channel partner may capture most of the value, while rule maintenance can preserve service-like costs.

factors.name: Market and beachhead
factors.rationale: One high-volume authority and contract-form family is a coherent, testable beachhead inside a very large Polish public-construction procurement base. The focus reduces initial legal variation. The actual number of repeat projects, addressable partner portfolios, and revenue available to this specific module are not established, so the narrow wedge could be operationally sensible but economically small.

factors.name: Competitive position and domination potential
factors.rationale: A counsel-approved pack embedded in a partner's installed workflow could become the default pre-submission pass for one form family. Conversely, PEF already supplies free structured exchange, and PlanRadar, Archdesk, and PROGPOL cover adjacent records and approvals. The incumbent owns the customer relationship and can copy, bundle, replace, or bargain down a narrow feature, making independent domination unlikely without contractual control.

factors.name: Expansion potential
factors.rationale: Winning one authority/form pack creates plausible adjacencies across more forms, authorities, partners, and payment-compliance workflows. Some extraction, testing, and exception infrastructure should transfer. Expansion is not automatically low-cost because each new rules surface can require specialist interpretation, new integrations, local exceptions, security review, and separate distribution agreement.

factors.name: Defensibility and durability
factors.rationale: Versioned rules, regression tests, embedded workflow position, and permissioned exception/cure labels could compound. The governing sources are public, the feature is technically reproducible, and rights to reuse even de-identified labels are not established. The channel partner can observe the product and has both distribution power and a credible path to internalize it.

factors.name: Strength of advantage
factors.rationale: A narrow source-linked precheck can be more trustworthy and operationally useful than generic document management, especially if it catches cross-document inconsistencies before submission. No measured result yet shows a material reduction in administrator labor, rejected draws, or days to payment, and capable incumbent systems already control much of the surrounding workflow.

factors.name: Timing and momentum
factors.rationale: Persistent statutory evidence requirements, digital PEF/API infrastructure, and AI-assisted document extraction make a focused rules layer more buildable now. Those same conditions also lower the cost for incumbents to add similar checks, and the evidence does not establish a time-limited regulatory or procurement window that strongly favors a new entrant.

factors.name: Distribution
factors.rationale: One embedded partner could deliver portfolio reach and avoid repeated direct contractor acquisition, matching the founder's preferences. No reviewed evidence shows partner interest, budget, data access, integration permission, or willingness to own onboarding and support. The redesign therefore concentrates acquisition into a small number of high-trust, potentially long-cycle enterprise sales rather than demonstrating a repeatable channel.

factors.name: Execution and risks
factors.rationale: A narrow prototype fits the founder's data and AI strengths, can use the family business as a permissioned test setting, and appears compatible with the stated validation capital. Production delivery still requires specialist legal ownership, enterprise integration, sensitive-data controls, version maintenance, security review, and partner-led onboarding and support. Those dependencies can exceed a 25-hour week before recurring economics are proven.

main_structural_strength: The redesign moves the cost and acquisition unit from a bespoke per-project tool to one narrowly governed rules pack embedded once and reused across a partner portfolio, creating a credible route to amortized legal configuration and recurring deployment.
primary_score_limiter: The same uncommitted incumbent partner must provide distribution, integration access, workflow data, pricing acceptance, portfolio activation, support capacity, and protection against appropriation, leaving economics and control jointly unproven.
strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Free PEF infrastructure and existing PlanRadar, Archdesk, and PROGPOL document/payment workflows show that much of the surrounding job is already supplied, while PlanRadar's published per-user pricing indicates strong price pressure; together they support the risk that this is an absorbable incumbent feature rather than a standalone high-margin business.
evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A paid incumbent pilot or binding commercial commitment covering multiple projects, with an explicit minimum fee, pricing unit, revenue share, activation obligation, and partner ownership of customer onboarding and first-line support.
A permissioned before-and-after pilot measuring the incidence and cash value of curable evidence defects, administrator hours, rejected draws, and days to payment attributable to the module.

Observed configuration, specialist-review, integration, security, and ongoing maintenance hours across several projects using the same authority/form family, sufficient to estimate gross margin and payback.

Contractual evidence that required records can be accessed and that de-identified exception/cure labels may be reused across the partner portfolio under appropriate privacy, retention, and audit controls.
Evidence of portfolio activation and renewal behavior showing that value persists across project turnover rather than ending after one implementation.
highest_value_structural_change: Turn the channel dependency into a contractually aligned OEM relationship: require a multi-project minimum annual commitment, make the partner responsible for integration delivery, customer onboarding, and first-line support, and secure rights to reuse governed exception/cure labels. This would convert a discretionary reseller into a recurring distribution asset while improving margin visibility and the only plausible data moat.
